en.text: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

zhSimplified.text: 设筵满屋，大家相争， 不如有块干饼，大家相安。

zhTraditional.text: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭， 不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。

en.text: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

zhSimplified.text: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子， 又在众子中同分产业。

zhTraditional.text: 僕人辦事聰明，必管轄貽羞之子， 又在眾子中同分產業。

en.text: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

zhSimplified.text: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金； 惟有耶和华熬炼人心。

zhTraditional.text: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金； 惟有耶和華熬煉人心。

en.text: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言； 说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。

zhTraditional.text: 行惡的，留心聽奸詐之言； 說謊的，側耳聽邪惡之語。

en.text: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

zhSimplified.text: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主； 幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。

zhTraditional.text: 戲笑窮人的，是辱沒造他的主； 幸災樂禍的，必不免受罰。

en.text: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

zhSimplified.text: 子孙为老人的冠冕； 父亲是儿女的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 子孫為老人的冠冕； 父親是兒女的榮耀。

en.text: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

zhSimplified.text: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜， 何况君王说谎话呢？

zhTraditional.text: 愚頑人說美言本不相宜， 何況君王說謊話呢？

en.text: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

zhSimplified.text: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉， 随处运动都得顺利。

zhTraditional.text: 賄賂在餽送的人眼中看為寶玉， 隨處運動都得順利。

en.text: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

zhSimplified.text: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱； 屡次挑错的，离间密友。

zhTraditional.text: 遮掩人過的，尋求人愛； 屢次挑錯的，離間密友。

en.text: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

zhSimplified.text: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心， 强如责打愚昧人一百下。

zhTraditional.text: 一句責備話深入聰明人的心， 強如責打愚昧人一百下。

en.text: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人只寻背叛， 所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人只尋背叛， 所以必有嚴厲的使者奉差攻擊他。

en.text: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

zhSimplified.text: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊， 不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。

zhTraditional.text: 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊， 不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。

en.text: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

zhSimplified.text: 以恶报善的， 祸患必不离他的家。

zhTraditional.text: 以惡報善的， 禍患必不離他的家。

en.text: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

zhSimplified.text: 纷争的起头如水放开， 所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。

zhTraditional.text: 紛爭的起頭如水放開， 所以，在爭鬧之先必當止息爭競。

en.text: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的， 这都为耶和华所憎恶。

zhTraditional.text: 定惡人為義的，定義人為惡的， 這都為耶和華所憎惡。

en.text: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人既无聪明， 为何手拿价银买智慧呢？

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人既無聰明， 為何手拿價銀買智慧呢？

en.text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

zhSimplified.text: 朋友乃时常亲爱， 弟兄为患难而生。

zhTraditional.text: 朋友乃時常親愛， 弟兄為患難而生。

en.text: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

zhSimplified.text: 在邻舍面前击掌作保 乃是无知的人。

zhTraditional.text: 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保 乃是無知的人。

en.text: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

zhSimplified.text: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯； 高立家门的，乃自取败坏。

zhTraditional.text: 喜愛爭競的，是喜愛過犯； 高立家門的，乃自取敗壞。

en.text: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处； 舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。

zhTraditional.text: 心存邪僻的，尋不着好處； 舌弄是非的，陷在禍患中。

en.text: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

zhSimplified.text: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦； 愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。

zhTraditional.text: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦； 愚頑人的父毫無喜樂。

en.text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

zhSimplified.text: 喜乐的心乃是良药； 忧伤的灵使骨枯干。

zhTraditional.text: 喜樂的心乃是良藥； 憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。

en.text: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人暗中受贿赂， 为要颠倒判断。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人暗中受賄賂， 為要顛倒判斷。

en.text: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 明哲人眼前有智慧； 愚昧人眼望地极。

zhTraditional.text: 明哲人眼前有智慧； 愚昧人眼望地極。

en.text: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦， 使母亲忧苦。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧子使父親愁煩， 使母親憂苦。

en.text: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

zhSimplified.text: 刑罚义人为不善； 责打君子为不义。

zhTraditional.text: 刑罰義人為不善； 責打君子為不義。

en.text: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 寡少言语的，有知识； 性情温良的，有聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 寡少言語的，有知識； 性情溫良的，有聰明。

en.text: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧； 闭口不说也可算为聪明。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧； 閉口不說也可算為聰明。
